preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have control of the ________ address (0x3aB960dCf9359083DC126222c03bfB0d2A3C9b6b)
Attacker must hold some MemeFarm tokens to sell

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner or ________ address controller: 1) First call qwidji() to blacklist the attacker's address (set _________[attacker] = true). 2) Then sell tokens through the DEX pair. The _transfer function will check if _________[sender] is true and revert with require(false), preventing the sale. 3) Meanwhile, other users can still buy tokens, creating a honeypot where only the owner can sell. This allows the owner to drain liquidity by selling their tokens while preventing others from selling.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract has a mapping `_________` (blacklist) that can be set via the `qwidji()` function, which is only callable by the `________` address (0x3aB960dCf9359083DC126222c03bfB0d2A3C9b6b). In the `_transfer()` function, there's a check: if `_________[sender]` is true, it calls `require(false)`, reverting the transaction. This means blacklisted addresses cannot transfer tokens. The `________` address is set to the same as `teamWalletAddress` in the constructor. The owner can change the `________` address via `setMarketinWalleAddress()`. The exploit involves: 1) Taking control of the `________` address (either by being the owner or impersonating it), 2) Blacklisting other holders to prevent them from selling, 3) Selling our own tokens to drain liquidity while others are trapped.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1) Impersonate the `________` address (0x3aB960dCf9359083DC126222c03bfB0d2A3C9b6b) using vm.prank. 2) Call `qwidji()` to blacklist a victim address (or multiple victims). 3) As the attacker (who is not blacklisted), sell tokens through the DEX pair to extract ETH from liquidity. 4) The oracle will check if attacker's ETH balance increased.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. In setUp(), get some MemeFarm tokens (the attacker needs tokens to sell). Since the contract mints total supply to `_msSender()` (which is the deployer), we need to impersonate the deployer to get tokens or transfer from an existing holder. 2. Impersonate the `________` address to call `qwidji()` and blacklist some victim addresses. 3. Approve the router to spend our tokens. 4. Call `swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens` on the router to sell tokens for ETH. 5. Verify ETH balance increased.
